title: Throughput-backed Weight Reservation and Cold-Start Insurance Policy
creator: Priya Patel
description: Problem: Customers on Dedicated fleets require predictable throughput and bounded cold-starts for SLA-bound routes. Current autoscaler and warm pool mechanisms reduce tail latency in practice but do not provide a clear contractual throughput guarantee or a billing/credit model for reserved preloaded capacity. This ticket defines a policy and control plane changes to attach throughput guarantees to weight residency reservations and a cold-start insurance mechanism that converts unused reserved start credits into customer credits or scaled-down costs. The feature spans admission control, reservation accounting, eviction policy, and KV cache seeding orchestration.
acceptance_criteria: Policy: Route-level throughput reservation can be requested and granted with an explicit duration and token rate; reservations are recorded in the fleet controller
Admission: Admission controller will enforce reservations by prioritizing weight residency and KV seeding for reserved routes ahead of opportunistic preloads
Accounting: Unused reservation credits are reconciled weekly and either refunded as usage credits or rolled into the customer’s burst pool per contract rules
Autoscaling integration: The autoscaler respects reserved throughput when computing scale targets and does not preempt reserved pods for opportunistic workloads
Observability: Console shows per-reservation SLO attainment, credit burn rate, and cold-start incidents attributable to reservation failures
Rollout: Gradual rollout to internal Dedicated fleets and two pilot customers with a feature flag; no regression in 99th-percentile latency during pilot
design_notes: Introduce a lightweight 'reservation' object in the control plane: (route_id, tokens_per_sec, min_residency, expiration) stored as strings in metadata store
Reservation enforcement is best-effort within min_residency window; we favor soft guarantees with explicit reconciliation instead of hard preemption to reduce noisy neighbor risks
KV seeding priority will be implemented using a per-tenant seeding queue with prioritized worker tokens; worker tasks mark seed progress with a TTL to avoid stale claims

Accounting model: two modes — prepaid credits (customer pays upfront for guaranteed throughput) and insurance mode (customer pays smaller monthly fee and receives credits for unmet reservation attainment)
We will add an eviction credit ledger: each eviction of a reserved slot decrements a credit; ledger used to calculate refunds or mitigation actions
implementation_plan: Phase 1: Control plane schema changes — add reservation records, credit ledger, and APIs (routes: /reservations, /reservations/{id}/status)
Phase 2: Fleet controller changes — honor reservations in placement and weight residency scoring; add eviction credit checkpoints
Phase 3: Autoscaler changes — include reservation tokens in scale target computation and introduce a reservation-aware downscaling cooldown
Phase 4: KV seeder enhancement — implement prioritized seeding queue with transactional TTL claims and progress reporting
Phase 5: Billing integration and reconciliation job — weekly job to reconcile reservation attainment and generate credit/refund events
Phase 6: UI & Observability — console panels, alerts, and SLO dashboards for reservations
rollout_plan: Feature flag gated: routing.reservations.enabled = false by default
Internal dogfood: enable for staging dedicated cluster and run synthetic traffic tests for two weeks
Pilot customers: enable for two enterprise customers on Dedicated and monitor credit burn and cold-start incidents for 30 days
Progressively increase allowed reservation sizes and surface billing changes once SLA metrics are stable
Full GA after remediation of issues discovered in pilots and completion of billing/legal sign-offs
metrics: reservation_granted_rate: number of reservations granted per hour
reservation_attainment_pct: percentage of reserved throughput served within SLA window
coldstart_incidents_reserved_routes: count of cold-starts for routes with active reservations
cost_delta_reserved_vs_opportunistic: delta in GPU-hours per token served for reserved traffic
